title: mcp: run_action and resume_run answer a code-less sandboxed action-body throw with the wrapper naming the body, where /actions answers 400 HOOK_ABORTED with the sentence
body:
domain:server#6 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5p3T5YWhLjurajudnQ

Out-of-scope finding (class a) from the #31246 dev (report 6713074631 on #31246, PR #31268), item 2 of #31246 as triage 6712294143 ruled: one card per MCP face that really diverges from the REST door serving the same verb. Filed by `domain:server#6`. ⛔ Not a claim. Measured by the dev on `main` with PR #31245 merged.

Reader: the seat that owns `packages/mcp`.

Suggested-grade: p2 (an agent sees an internal action-body name; the actions door hides it).

**Observed:** `tools/call run_action` / `resume_run` where `runAction` throws a code-less sandboxed action-body throw answers the bare wrapper text naming the body; `/actions` (`HttpDispatcher.handleActions`) answers `400 HOOK_ABORTED` with the inner sentence. A bare `Error` answers its bare text with no code vs `/actions` `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` same text; `SQLITE_BUSY` answers `{ code: SQLITE_BUSY, driver text, no status }` vs `/actions` `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` with `declaredCode: SQLITE_BUSY`.

**Expected:** `run_action` / `resume_run` (`errorResultFromThrown`) answer a throw the way `/actions` does, through the one reader that door uses, never a copy. Pins per case above, red first.

Note (REST side, not this card): `/actions` answering a driver string code as `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` while `/data` answers `500 DATABASE_ERROR` is itself a door divergence the dev noted; the lane decides whether MCP follows `/actions` as it stands or that door is fixed first.

Dedupe words: mcp run_action HOOK_ABORTED, errorResultFromThrown code-less, run_action actions door parity.
